To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

environmental uncertainty permits use of telecommunication with suppliers, product information intensity permits use of telecomm with customers, value chain information int permits use of telecom with customers, IS maturity facilitates impact of telecomm on perf.

environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensities, and IS maturity, affect the use and impact telecommunication based interorganization systems have on organizational performance.

Environmental uncertainty permits the use the use of telecomm links with suppliers; product information intensity and value-chain information intensity are associated with the use telecomm links with customers and value-chain partners respectively; and IS maturity enhances the impact of telecomm links on organizational performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the antecedents and consequences of telecommunication links in the context of IOS.
the antecedents and impact of telecommunication based information systems used to link with customers and suppliers.
the use of inter-organizational telecommunication systems
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
telecommunication links with external organizations are important to firms.
telecommunication links between organizations are important, and that the use of such links is affected by environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensities.
environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensities and IS maturity all have an impact on the use and impact on telecommunication links on performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of telecommunicaiton based links with customers or suppliers is positively affected by environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensty and that the impact these links have on organizational perfomance is enhanced by information systems maturity.

environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensities, and IS maturity are important factors in determining the use and impact on performance of telecommunication based information systems.

the use of telecommunciations to link to suppliers and customers has been shown to be related to the level of uncertainty in the environment, the intensity of information processing within the value chain and the level of IS maturity within the organization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
environmental uncertainty and IS maturity are important antecedents of the impact of interorganization telecommunication links on firm performance.
IS maturity does not necessarily enhance the use of tele communication based links, but it does facilitate the impact such links can have on organizational performance.

environmental uncertainty, product and value chain information intensities and IS maturity have an impact on the use of inter-organizational telecommunication systems and the impact these systems have on organizational performance.
